description:
Get holder concentration and adversarial-label stats for a crown. Sourced from /api/v2/registration/{id}/holders; data refreshes daily.

Params: crown_id (number)
Returns: text report with totalHolders, top10/50/100/200 concentration, walletsForHalf and, for a coin launched on Chain Daddy, bundled at open (share of supply bought in the opening blocks by wallets buying in the same block, and how many opening buyers are linked to the creator). Flagged-wallet counts (snipers, bundlers, insiders) are unavailable and not reported.
Errors: CROWN_NOT_FOUND, NO_DATA, API_ERROR
name: get_holders
title: Get holder stats
